cases.task_definition: Navigating treatment decisions when evidence-based guidelines for one condition directly conflict with guidelines for a co-existing condition, requiring explicit adjudication of competing risks and benefits without a single authoritative answer. Most guidelines are developed for single-disease populations; conflict is near-universal in patients with multimorbidity, yet no standard framework exists for resolving it.
